key_path: human signs up at supabase.com/dashboard/sign-up (GitHub, ChatGPT, SSO or email+password)
`supabase login`: browser flow (or `--no-browser` prints URL + verification code). Alternatively dashboard > Account > Access Tokens > create PAT (sbp_...)
Management API (`POST /v1/projects`) creates a project in the default org; `GET/POST /v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys` returns publishable/secret keys
MCP: `claude mcp add --transport http supabase https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp` then OAuth via DCR, picking the org

agent_native_auth.cli_device_flow: yes: `supabase login` opens a browser and polls; `--no-browser` for remote. `--token`/SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN for CI
agent_native_auth.mcp_oauth_dcr: yes: registration_endpoint https://api.supabase.com/platform/oauth/apps/register. AS also supports a jwt-bearer grant
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes: Management API (OpenAPI) creates projects and project API keys. OAuth apps for partner platforms
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes: MCP OAuth has granular scopes (projects:read/write, database:read/write, edge_functions, storage, secrets...). Docs mention scoped PATs; MCP URL params project_ref, read_only, features
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes: 2 free projects, no card (pause after inactivity)
agent_native_auth.claimable_anonymous: partial: Management API has project claim tokens (/v1/projects/{ref}/claim-token, /v1/organizations/{slug}/project-claim/{token}, /v1/oauth/authorize/project-claim) so a platform can create a project and hand it to a user. Needs the platform's own Supabase org; there is no anonymous agent path like Neon's

remote.auth: OAuth DCR (default) or PAT bearer header; labelled 'Beta' in resource metadata

mcp.type: product + docs (SQL, migrations, Edge Functions, branching, logs, search_docs)
mcp.one_click: config generator / install buttons for Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI, etc. on the MCP docs page

score_justification: DCR MCP with fine-grained scopes and safety URL params, a full Management API that mints project keys, and 'Continue with ChatGPT' signup. Still no anonymous path for an agent working alone.
best_practice: MCP URL params (project_ref, read_only=true, features=...) plus OAuth scopes give agents least-privilege access without custom tokens
biggest_gap: No anonymous or claimable database for a lone agent (claim tokens exist only for platforms with their own org), so a human account is always needed first
